name: Zombville Stadium
description: Zombville Stadium after dark: the football field turned into an emergency treatment center for the outbreak's victims, overrun and abandoned. Tents, triage, generators and light towers; the stands all round and the tunnels they come out of. Only the camp's lights to see by.

props.text: EMERGENCY|TREATMENT CENTER|ALL ARRIVALS|TO SCREENING|NO WEAPONS|BEYOND THIS POINT
